title: Service status
idea: Service status: A few relevant capabilities show last verification time, impact and the permitted recovery action.
audience: People who need to inspect service within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Users need to know whether a particular task is currently possible.
avoidWhen: A green banner would claim availability without a live check.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its inspect service priority and explicit commitment contract: Separate configuration, reachability and verified task readiness.
navigation: Service status keeps the current inspect service context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A few relevant capabilities show last verification time, impact and the permitted recovery action.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect service; users need to know whether a particular task is currently possible.
composition.priority: Separate configuration, reachability and verified task readiness.

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect service context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize affected capability and workaround before historical charts.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the service status structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect service content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Separate configuration, reachability and verified task readiness.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect service content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Separate configuration, reachability and verified task readiness.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect service context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
